package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/alpha"
	"app/shared"
	"app/zeta"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()

		// Middleware
		r.Use(zeta.Logged)
		r.Use(shared.Session)
		r.Use(alpha.Remembered)

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", zeta.Index)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
